== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ホスの位置以外の位置では戦闘力－1。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コールド・アサルト・トルーパーは氷点下で活動するよう訓練され、特殊装備を装着している。ブリザード・フォースのスノートルーパーはAT-ATと連係して戦うことが多い。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Snowtrooper.

'''Lore''' — Cold Assault troopers are trained to operate below freezing and wear special equipment. Blizzard Force’s snowtroopers often fight in coordination with AT-ATs.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Power −1 at a location other than a Hoth location.

The Japanese face uses 位置 (location) for the power penalty. The English face says site. Both print power 2 and ability 1. The black-border Japanese Hoth face has the same game text.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-snowtrooper-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Snowtrooper]].</ref>
